Question ID: ENV_U04_L03_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ENV.RES.03

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Energy Production Technologies
Stimulus: Energy technology data/comparison

A student reviews the required environmental evidence and must explain the first clear pattern. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, Identify the resource or technology. Then use the required stimulus (Energy technology data/comparison) to connect the visible evidence to resource availability, energy technology, land use, and management tradeoffs. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ENV.RES.03 and avoids the common mistake: choosing the option that sounds best without comparing costs, benefits, renewal rate, and environmental impact.
